source_atom.claim_scope: fixed selected witness-component fibre products at first order; base tangent image is the intersection of component images

target_atom.target: derive same-curve Selmer dimension two plus a nonzero transverse localization witness from exact complex analytic rank two without reimporting the target premise

enabling_assumptions: The proposed BSD repair is only an intersection/pullback/preimage of already available linearized carrier or local-condition subspaces; it introduces no new generative operator.
The target detector/localization map is linear on the compared Selmer-level representation.
Every input reachable subspace in the proposed conjunctive repair is contained in the kernel of the required transverse detector, or otherwise omits the desired detector direction.
disanalogies: Hodge H4d1c-b is a first-order deformation/fibre-product statement; Selmer groups and localization are Galois-cohomological objects, not Hodge witness moduli.

Arithmetic sums, extension classes, connecting morphisms, derived heights, Euler-system derivatives, pairings, quotients, base change/return maps, or genuinely new cohomology classes are generative operations and are outside this transfer.
Castella arXiv:2312.01481 provides a good-ordinary generalized-Kato theorem cell; it does not say exact complex analytic rank two alone forces nonzero localization.
predicted_principle: A repair made solely by adding compatibility constraints to existing kernel-confined carriers cannot create a missing transverse localization coordinate; escaping the obstruction requires a typed generative operation with an explicit nonzero detector effect.

cheapest_falsifier.model: Let V=span{k,w}, loc(k)=0, loc(w)=1. Any family of subspaces W_i contained in ker(loc)=span{k} has intersection contained in ker(loc), hence no conjunctive/fibre-product repair can produce loc != 0.
cheapest_falsifier.contrast: If one instead adjoins/generated-spans a transverse vector w, span{k,w} has nonzero localization. This is a different operator family, so the nonexpansion result is scoped rather than universal.

difference_witness.source_operator: fibre product / simultaneous compatibility, tangent image intersection
difference_witness.target_bad_mapping: treat intersection/pullback of kernel-confined Selmer carriers as if it could create a transverse localization direction
difference_witness.target_escape_operator: sum/extension/connecting map/derivative/new class with a proved detector effect
